verdict.rationale: Hardware support is a fair question to ask of a desktop operating system, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows macOS running on low-cost single-board computers. The only Raspberry Pi mention is users saying they miss macOS tools like pbcopy/pbpaste when working on a Pi, which implies macOS is not available there.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full desktop developer experience running on low-cost single-board computers
